name: Moonthorn Hunting Knife
description: A small hunting knife with a handle worked from a moonthorn wolf's shed canine — given rather than bought, typically to an elf who has earned a specific relationship with a wolf or pack.
narrative_effects: Carries the same mechanics as a standard knife.
Provenance matters more than form — wearing a Moonthorn knife signals a relationship to other elves who understand the craft; the knife itself does nothing extraordinary.
